name: night_pursuit_cinematic
character: A film chase cue judged as a build-hit-release piece: a motif on the horns that changes at every camera, a pulse that never stops and one slow-motion jump; it starts as `cinematic` and changes nothing until a render measures a reason.

focus.label: a line the ear can follow
focus.reason: this type is defined by a figure, so a piece that declares it must carry one; the same list means a lead or a vocal is checked exactly like a melody
